lines: Welcome to the Clover Post Office! I'm Pip, your post assistant!
We've got letters and parcels waiting for brave little couriers like you.
Want to take a delivery? The quest board has all the latest!
Oh! Hello... I didn't see you there.
These flowers are my pride and joy. Do you like them?
If you ever find a moonflower, I'd love to see it.
Well hello there, friend! Welcome to my little corner of the forest.
The kettle's always on. Stay for a story?
I'm saving up for a proper café one day. A cozy one!
The light falls differently here at dusk...
I study how the forest remembers the moon.
A rare flower blooms only at night. I've been looking for it.
Mm... hello? Oh, you're real. Nice to meet you.
I tend the burrows here. The rabbits are very opinionated.
If you find any shiny pebbles, I'd be most grateful.
There's my favorite courier! The parcels miss you when you're gone.
We make a great team, you and me.
